answer: Every identity owes audit duty. Each epoch a sparrow roster gives each identity three others to audit, and the auditor files a sonnet report naming target, work, and verdict. Each locks a 60 credit bond. A pulse call opens the window; a missed or copied report burns the bond. The k-th fake still owes three audits and 60 bond, so 1,000 fakes owe 60,000 bond and 3,000 audits, since a sparrow re-audit burns any bond behind a disagreeing verdict. A rented-auditor ring fails the same check. An honest identity owes one bond and three audits, and keeps its bond when its reports match.
